decisions.evidence: The exact Definition qualifies its claim by “in length coordinates”. In general [g_ab]=m^2/([x^a][x^b]); hence components in coordinates all measured in metres are dimensionless. The displayed polar chart is mixed: [t]=[r]=m, [theta]=[phi]=1, so [g_theta_theta]=[g_phi_phi]=m^2. This does not contradict the qualified sentence, which does not call angles length coordinates. The current consumer uses the correct inverse angular block r^(-2) gamma^(AB), density r^2 sin(theta), and potential unit m^(-2) in steps 1.2–3.1. No source edit is warranted.
